## What

- [ ] L3 locale pack (deltas only — no playbook fork)
- [ ] Playbook / eval change
- [ ] Docs / site
- [ ] Other

## Checks

- [ ] `make check` (required if locale, playbook, field-note, or site generator changed)
- [ ] `make site` and `docs/data/progress.json` committed when coverage changed
- [ ] No PII / phone numbers
- [ ] Status is `draft` unless the pack has real local examples (not the template)

## Notes

Highest leverage: an L3 district pack. Field-note **Results** must be real — see `guides/receipt-plan.md`.
